newsitem.title: DUBAI: ANZ launches Islamic investment fund.
newsitem.headline: ANZ launches Islamic investment fund.

text.p: ANZ Grindlays Bank said it had launched a $100 million close-ended Islamic investment fund which complied with the rules of sharia law.
ANZ Grindlays and International Finance Company are lead investors, each investing $5 million in the First ANZ International Modaraba Ltd fund, ANZ said in a statement.
It said the fund -- to be listed on the Bahrain Stock Exchange -- would provide medium-term financing for assets mainly in the Middle East, North Africa and "emerging Asian countries".
It would finance assets such as plant and machinery, aircraft, containers and commercial vehicles.
Income will be distributed by twice-yearly dividend. The offer closes on June 19 and the minimum investment is $10,000.
